name: Kontiki example
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'trap "" HUP; export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1; kontiki_registry --config registry/config.yaml >> /tmp/kontiki-registry.log 2>&1 & python -m kontiki.runner.__main__ inventory.service.Inventory --config inventory/config.yaml >> /tmp/inventory.log 2>&1 & python -m kontiki.runner.__main__ checkout.service.Checkout --config checkout/config.yaml >> /tmp/checkout.log 2>&1 &'

postAttachCommand.welcome: echo 'Checkout and Inventory are up. Run: make example — then kontiki-tui'
